securityInvariants: The App Harness ledger is the only action, retry, and idempotency store.
The overlay creates no Durable Object, KV, D1, R2, or local action cache.
The model chooses commands explicitly; the Gatekeeper contains no phase-to-next-command selection.
Every external executor call is bound to a durable domain key: work-item ID for issues, job and generation for Sandbox, or dispatch key for promotion.
Only the App Harness ambient account is enabled by default for a fresh Workshop deployment.
The persisted admin policy remains the source of truth after initialization.
Only the deployment-owned app_harness ambient Gatekeeper receives the autonomous demo rule.
The Gatekeeper must still mark each command autoApprovable, preserving Cloudflare OS's two-signal approval design.
The user who owns the workspace remains recorded as the authority behind every automatically applied action.

patches.search: // Find the external conversation's chat if it exists.

securityInvariants: External messages receive only ambient singleton capabilities already enabled by the Workshop administrator policy.
Provisioning happens before a new chat freezes its binding seed and is idempotent for reused workspaces.
The external gateway does not receive credentials or directly construct a Gatekeeper session.
Only the deployment-owned app_harness vendor is forced into every demo workspace.
All other ambient vendors retain Cloudflare OS's stored administrator policy and optional default.
